name: Nemurihime
source: The youngest of the three sisters and a girl of few words. She is always sleeping or on the verge of falling asleep. She is a member of the gardening club and takes care of the gardening club's flowers every day. Nemurihime also loves talking about all kinds of plants and flowers.
